case_name: Smt. Savita Kumari vs Ramu Sahu on 14 August, 2025

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Ramu Sahu, Officer Surveyor, posted at office of the Director, 7th Floor (Block-'A', 'F' & 'G') Karpuri Thakur Sadan, CGO Complex, Ashiana Digha Road, P.O. +P.S. Ashiana Nagar, Dist.- Patna- 800025 (Bihar) through its Director
parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. Savita Kumari, wife of Ramu Sahu, daughter of Late Surya Narayan Sah, permanent resident of House No.11, Near Indu Bhawan, Behind Yamuna Apartment, Gandhi Nagar, Boring Road, P.O. & P.S. Patna Shri Krishnapuri, District Patna, Bihar

facts_of_case: The respondent/husband filed a suit for dissolution of marriage which was allowed by the trial court. The husband has been directed to pay permanent alimony of Rs. 15,00,000/- to the wife.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to disclose material information can be considered as cruelty.
legal_principles.held: The behaviour of the wife became more cruel, thus, he was compelled to leave his Govt. accommodation in the year 2016.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to discharge their obligations as a spouse can be considered as cruelty.
legal_principles.held: The wife never discharged her obligation as wife so he filed a case of restitution of conjugal right.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is being taken up together and as such, are being allowed.
